 LIHEAP applications now open for fall utility bills
 6 hours ago 
 Porsha Hernandez , 
 Share This Story 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 email 
 Print 
 Linkedin 
 Reddit 
 SOUTH-CENTRAL KENTUCKY – Temperatures are lowering, and with the heat turning up in homes, utility bills could also be on the rise. 
 Kentucky families have the opportunity for assistance by the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program. The applications opened on Nov. 9 and will be accepted through Dec. 18.  
 To qualify, families must be at or fall below 150% of the federal poverty guideline. 
 “People often have to make choices. Really tough choices about whether to get their medicine or whether or not to heat this room or that room in their house because things can be so limited for folks and so what this does is it allows people to get a little bit ahead on their bills,” said Sara Hill, the Community Development manager with CCAP. 
 To apply, you can go online or contact your local community action agency.
